content.caseIdentity: Municipal Council, Ratlam v Vardhichand, (1980) 4 SCC 162
content.facts: Nuisance turns on substantial and unreasonable interference; public authorities cannot evade statutory nuisance duties merely by pleading financial difficulty.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Nuisance turns on substantial and unreasonable interference; public authorities cannot evade statutory nuisance duties merely by pleading financial difficulty.
content.holding: Nuisance turns on substantial and unreasonable interference; public authorities cannot evade statutory nuisance duties merely by pleading financial difficulty.
content.relevance: Apply the ratio to the proved facts.
